# Technical_Program_Officer_Autonomy

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The authority granted to a program manager to independently select, fund, and terminate projects without external bureaucratic approval, based on technical merit. Enables agile resource allocation in iNEST/TCC, allowing rapid pivots between competing architectural approaches (e.g., spiking vs. reservoir) based on empirical results.
